rules: Always run verification checks (pnpm build, pnpm test, pnpm lint) before concluding a task.
Do NOT modify files in core/ kernel/ or container/ directories.
Do NOT bypass intermediate service layers to import directly from vendor libraries.
Register newly created services in register-core.ts and map their health checks.
Do NOT expose credentials, tokens, or private secrets in discovery, logs, or doctor output.
If the requirement is a multi-step business process, use the Workflow Framework.
Do NOT confuse Workflow with Queue (durable background execution), EventBus (decoupled event propagation), or Scheduler (periodic execution).
implementationWorkflow: Configure settings using ConfigManager via register-core.ts
